title: Speed truth: foul line + pin contact
instructions:
For each clip, mark two moments. True speed = 60 ft ÷ the time between them, with no lane geometry involved, so this checks which speed anchor is right (DEC-112).

Each moment opens at Claude's estimate (grey tick under the slider). Step frame by frame with ← → and press Enter on the exact frame. Click the frame to zoom.

events.label: Ball crosses the foul line
events.help: First frame where the ball is over the foul line (the line nearest the camera).

events.label: Ball touches the head pin
events.help: First frame where the ball touches the head pin. If contact is hidden, the first frame the head pin moves.
